assets.headline: What closing the books at a 12-person café taught us about month-end
assets.body:
Last month we sat with Mei, who runs two cafés in Tiong Bahru. Her month-end close took three evenings.

Not because the numbers were hard. Because 400 card transactions had to be matched to receipts by hand.

We plugged LedgerAI into her bank feed on a Tuesday. By Thursday the close was done in under three hours, and most of that was her reviewing exceptions we had flagged.

It's rarely a people problem. It's a tooling gap. Happy to share what we've learned about closing small-business books faster.

assets.headline: Unpopular opinion: your bookkeeper shouldn't be matching transactions
assets.body:
Every accountant I talk to in Singapore spends the first week of the month doing the same thing: matching bank lines to invoices.

That is not accounting. That is data entry with a CPA's hourly rate.

We built LedgerAI so the matching happens while you sleep and your bookkeeper spends their time on the 5% that actually needs judgement.
